title: Solve Systems by Graphing Core Test
description: Solve systems by graphing both lines and identifying their intersection point.

questions.questionText: Solve the system by graphing: y = -2x + 1 and y = x + 7. The lines intersect at which point?
questions.explanation: To solve by graphing, graph both lines and read the point where they intersect. That point satisfies both equations.
